technology_name: EcoScape Solution - For Urban & Rural Land Use
institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
problem_solved: Degradation of urban and rural spaces, rising urban heat island effects, topsoil erosion, and the ecological burden of high-maintenance, non-native decorative landscaping.
description: An innovative, ecological landscaping service designed to transform underutilized spaces into climate-resilient green infrastructure. The service moves beyond aesthetic beautification by integrating drought-tolerant native species, vertical gardens, and groundcover planting. It emphasizes sustainable lifecycle management through smart irrigation, organic mulching, and eco-friendly construction materials to minimize resource consumption.
applications:
• Smart City urban renewal and municipal park development

• Green infrastructure for institutional campuses and corporate IT parks

• Roadside green belts and ecological restoration of waterbody peripheries

• Heritage zone beautification and eco-tourism landscape planning
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management
